该 zip 文件包含 ComfyUI 工作流程，用于生成短片“Frostveil - Call to the Heroes”中的影片剪辑和徽标：

标志

要制作徽标，请使用名为的工作流程工作流程_logo.json。它使用 LayerDiffusion 和 ControlNet 来帮助匹配所需的文本和字体，同时保留透明背景：

它可以生成以下标志：

剪辑

使用名为工作流程剪辑.json。它看起来像这样：工作流程本身分为以下部分：

  • 配置组：在最左侧，您可以设置图像分辨率、检查点和 LoRas，以及正面和负面提示。

  • 基础抽样：快速生成许多图像，直到找到您喜欢的图像。

  • 高档 2x：提高图像质量

  • 图像到视频：这使用 SVD1.1 并生成分辨率为 1024x576 的 25 帧数据。

  • 视频放大：这里有多种可用选项：SUPIR、CCSR 和常规型号高档。我几乎只使用 SUPIR 来制作视频《英雄召唤》。

  • 帧插值：最后一个节点会将您的视频升级到 24 fps，因此看起来很流畅。

感谢 ComfyUI 社区让这一切成为可能！

o.en:
The zip file contains the ComfyUI workflows which were used to generate the movie clips and the logo in the short film "Frostveil - Call to the Heroes":

Logo

To make a logo, use the workflow namedworkflow_logo.json. It uses LayerDiffusion and ControlNet to help match the wanted text and font while preserving a transparent background:

It can generate the following logo:

Clips

Use the workflow namedworkflow_clips.json. It looks like this:The workflow itself is divided in the following sections:

  • Configuration groups: on the very left, where you will set your image resolution, checkpoint and LoRas, and the positive and negative prompts.

  • Base sampling:to quickly generate many images until you find one you like.

  • Upscale 2x:to enhance the image quality

  • Image-to-video: this uses SVD1.1 and generates 25 frames worth of data in a resolution of 1024x576.

  • Video upscaling:there are multiple available options here: SUPIR, CCSR and regular model upscale. I used almost exclusively SUPIR for the video Call to the Heroes.

  • Frame interpolation:this last node will bring your upscaled video to 24 fps so it looks smooth.

Thanks to the ComfyUI community for making this possible!
